content: watchdog 7.1.0 (2026-11-04) is latest; 7.0.0 (2026-10-31) DROPPED Python 3.9+3.10 (requires-python >=3.11), changed pattern matching from path.match() to path.full_match() (glob *.py must become **/*.py), split FileAttribEvent/DirAttribEvent out of on_modified, added Observer context manager + follow_symlink + ignore_policy. 6.x series = only 6.0.0 (2024-11-01), supports Python 3.9-3.10; 5.0.0 dropped 3.8. EventDebouncer (watchdog.utils.event_debouncer) exists since v3.0.0 with positional __init__(debounce_interval_seconds, events_callback); kwarg renamed to debounce_interval only in 7.0 (old name deprecated but works) - call positionally for 3.x-7.x compat. 7.1.0 fixed inotify queue-overflow reconciliation + lazy inotify instance + watch dirs moved into recursive watch. FSEvents coalesces same-inode events, may emit historic events up to 30s before watch start (suppress via snapshot), macOS default observer=FSEvents, Linux=inotify (fs.inotify.max_user_watches limit, default often 8192), BSD kqueue FD-per-file (unscalable), PollingObserver fallback for network FS. Official debouncing recipe: EventDebouncer thread + handler on_any_event forwarding.
